channel.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
channel.desc: James Dainard is used to partnering with investors, but this time he's taking a leap of faith on someone close to home; his longtime contractor and friend, Kenny, wants to step out from behind the tool belt and partner with James on a flip; Kenny has found a tempting deal in a great part of Seattle, but James knows the transition from contractor to partner isn't easy; Kenny has a history of blowing budgets and stretching schedules, and the house itself is a puzzle.
